messages.subject: Calderwell CV-7 - engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Following our call, please find our engagement letter attached for signature. Scope covers the DVSA notification, the recall action plan and our advice on regulatory and civil exposure. Estimate for the first phase is £45-60k plus VAT, which we'll keep under review.

Please sign and return the duplicate. We've already started given the safety dimension.

Tom

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
